selection_rule: Select the smallest non-redundant capability set that owns the decision. Do not list both an umbrella capability and its method unless each changes handling.

capability_definitions.core-direct: Routine direct implementation and its obvious targeted check when no specialist changes handling. Frontier Core may remain the workflow owner while a specialist is active, but do not also report core-direct as an independent capability unless direct Routine handling changes the decision.
capability_definitions.architecture: Ownership, lifecycle, state, data-flow, or responsibility boundary design.
capability_definitions.debugging: Causal diagnosis of an unknown, recurring, or intermittent defect.
capability_definitions.security: Secrets, authentication, authorization, permissions, privacy, or another independent trust boundary.
capability_definitions.performance: Measured latency, CPU, memory, I/O, throughput, or real-time budget work.
capability_definitions.portfolio: A decisive evaluator or structurally different candidate is required because the current choice cannot be judged.
capability_definitions.recovery: Reconcile uncertain, stale, interrupted, or partially failed state before resuming.
capability_definitions.migration: Compatible expand/migrate/cutover/contract phases; this already includes compatibility of the surface being migrated.
capability_definitions.verification: General non-trivial proof selection when no narrower evidence capability below owns the proof.
capability_definitions.review: Material finding adjudication or pure-refactor equivalence; this already owns ordinary proof needed for that review.
capability_definitions.feedback-flow: Fast/Targeted/Subsystem/Full project feedback routing; this is the narrower owner instead of generic verification.
capability_definitions.self-improvement-governance: Proposal, prototype, measured promotion, and publication authority for FrontierLoop itself.
capability_definitions.source-verification: Exact version detection and decisive primary-source verification.
capability_definitions.public-contract: Independent observable API, command, schema, format, error, or compatibility contract design. Select it whenever a prompt explicitly introduces or changes a public API or other observable contract, even when frontier-architecture owns the workflow; omit only when migration already owns that same compatibility surface.
capability_definitions.runtime-evidence: Native UI, focus, timing, audio, installation, migration, or recovery observation; this is the narrower owner instead of generic verification.

subsumption_rules: feedback-flow subsumes generic verification for project feedback-ladder work
runtime-evidence subsumes generic verification when the task is specifically to prove native runtime behavior
review subsumes generic verification for a pure-refactor equivalence judgment
migration subsumes public-contract when compatibility concerns only the surface being migrated
